options.name: port
options.help: listen port (default: config file, $PORT or 8080)

options.name: bind
options.help: address to bind (default: config file, $BIND or 0.0.0.0)

options.name: upstream
options.help: upstream Prometheus URL (default: config file, $PROM_URL or http://localhost:9090)

options.name: prom-prefix
options.help: path under which Prometheus is proxied (default: config file, $PROM_PREFIX or /prom); empty string proxies everything

options.name: static-dir
options.help: directory to serve (default: config file, $STATIC_DIR or static next to the script)

options.name: config-js
options.help: config.js to serve at /config.js (default: config file, $CONFIG_JS or config.js next to the script)

options.name: battery
options.setting-help: serve config.js with the battery panels enabled

value-help.on: the battery KPIs and charts appear (the reload of the page picks it up)

options.help: enable battery support in the served config.js (default: config file, $BATTERY or off)

options.name: max-clients
options.setting-help: simultaneous HTTP clients (static pages + the proxy); extras get an immediate 503
options.help: maximum concurrent HTTP clients (pages + proxy); extras get an immediate 503 (default: config file, $MAX_CLIENTS or 64; 0 = unlimited)

options.name: client-timeout
options.setting-help: kick idle keep-alive HTTP clients after this long

value-help.0: never (the built-in slowloris cap still applies on the metrics surfaces that have one)

options.help: seconds an idle keep-alive HTTP client is kept before being kicked (default: config file, $CLIENT_TIMEOUT or 300; 0 = off)

options.name: max-conn-per-ip
options.setting-help: simultaneous HTTP connections from one peer IP
options.help: maximum concurrent HTTP connections from one peer IP; extras get an immediate 503 (default: config file, $MAX_CONN_PER_IP or 0 = no per-IP limit)

options.name: control-port
options.help: JSON-lines control server target: unix socket path (default: /tmp/dashboard-<port>.socket) or TCP port number on 127.0.0.1 (e.g. 15598); 0 = off. Talk to it with dashboard-ctl.py (default: config file, $CTL)

options.name: control-token
options.help: require a token on control connections: the client authenticates with {"cmd": "auth", "token": ...}; over the unix socket a trusted peer (root, the daemon's own user or --control-trust-uids — SO_PEERCRED) skips the token (default: config file, $CONTROL_TOKEN or none)

options.name: control-token-file
options.help: the control token from a file (the first line; e.g. a systemd LoadCredential or a key file; must be owner-only 0600) — takes the place of --control-token; giving both is an error (env CONTROL_TOKEN_FILE)

options.name: control-ops-token
options.help: a second, read-only control token: sessions authenticating with it may run the show/clear verbs only (no set/unset, no request reload, no shutdown) — the ops shift against the admin key, both audited (default: config file, $CONTROL_OPS_TOKEN or none)

options.name: control-ops-token-file
options.help: the read-only ops token from a file (the first line; must be owner-only 0600) — takes the place of --control-ops-token; giving both is an error (env CONTROL_OPS_TOKEN_FILE)

options.name: control-trust-uids
options.help: extra peer uids the unix control socket trusts without the token (SO_PEERCRED — a local systemd unit speaks without the secret); root and the daemon's own user are always trusted (default: config file, $CONTROL_TRUST_UIDS or none)

options.name: control-ops-verbs
options.help: the read-only ops role's RBAC policy: the verbs its sessions may run, comma-separated (default: show,clear; validated against the control grammar at start)

options.name: metrics-server
options.setting-help: the dashboard's own Prometheus /metrics endpoint (needs a token; the address is --metrics-listen)

value-help.on: serve /metrics on the configured listen address

options.help: serve the dashboard's own Prometheus /metrics endpoint (the uptime, the request counters, the proxied query total, the client gate) — off by default and a token is mandatory when on (default: config file, $METRICS_SERVER or off)

options.name: metrics-listen
options.help: the metrics bind address HOST:PORT (default: config file, $METRICS_LISTEN or 127.0.0.1:9452)

options.name: metrics-token
options.help: require Authorization: Bearer <token> on the /metrics endpoint — mandatory when --metrics-server is on (default: config file, $METRICS_TOKEN)

options.name: metrics-token-file
options.help: the metrics bearer token from a file (the first line; must be owner-only 0600) — takes the place of --metrics-token; giving both is an error (env METRICS_TOKEN_FILE)

options.name: metrics-max-clients
options.help: maximum concurrent /metrics clients; extras get an immediate 503, 0 = unlimited (default: config file, $METRICS_MAX_CLIENTS or 16)

options.name: metrics-client-timeout
options.help: seconds an idle /metrics client is kept before the socket times out, 0 = the built-in 5 s cap (default: config file, $METRICS_CLIENT_TIMEOUT or 5)

options.name: metrics-max-conn-per-ip
options.help: maximum concurrent /metrics connections from one peer IP, 0 = no per-IP limit (default: config file, $METRICS_MAX_CONN_PER_IP or 0)

options.name: audit-log
options.help: DSH audit trail: a file path or - for stdout (the docker/journald way); default: the XDG state home (~/.local/state/dashboard/audit.log)

options.name: audit-max-mb
options.help: rotate the audit log at this size in MB, keeping 3 backups; 0 = no size rotation (default %(default)s)

options.name: audit-files
options.help: rotated audit backups to keep (default %(default)s)

options.name: no-audit-log
options.help: disable the DSH audit trail

options.name: log-level

value-help.DEBUG: every request, the proxy detail, the gate decisions
value-help.INFO: lifecycle, control commands, the upstream up/down flips

options.help: log level (default: config file or INFO); DEBUG logs every request

options.name: log-queries
options.setting-help: log the proxied Prometheus queries at INFO

value-help.on: every /prom query with its status and duration

options.help: log proxied Prometheus queries at INFO level

options.name: log-access
options.setting-help: log every HTTP request at INFO

value-help.on: audit trail for who loaded the page and polled /prom and when

options.help: log every HTTP request at INFO (default: config file, $LOG_ACCESS or quiet)

options.name: local-time
options.help: log timestamps in the system time zone instead of UTC
